text: The Court held that anticipatory bail under Section 438 requires consideration of the facts of the case and is not barred solely because the allegation is serious.
Section 438 grants the High Court and Court of Session power to direct release in the event of arrest. The court must balance personal liberty with a fair investigation.
The appeal concerning property possession was dismissed because the claimant did not establish continuous possession.
Section 34 of the Arbitration Act permits limited judicial review and does not allow a court to reappreciate evidence as an appellate court.
